followup-onboarding-demo-baseurl.title: Onboarding demo session missing baseUrlOverrides
followup-onboarding-demo-baseurl.description: OnboardingViewModel.kt:467 validates OPENAI_API against settingsState.openaiBaseUrl, but OnboardingDemoController.kt:77 does NOT pass baseUrlOverrides when creating the demo session (real runtime does at MainActivity.kt:527,656). Result: proxy-based onboarding validates OK, then Run Demo fails one step later. Tests miss the seam (validation stops at 904 in OnboardingViewModelTest; demo mocks the controller in DemoStepStateTest:78).
acceptCriteria: Demo controller propagates baseUrlOverrides from settingsState
New end-to-end test covers demo session creation with custom base URL
followup-onboarding-demo-baseurl.note: Codex MED: test exercises only resolveBaseUrlOverrides() helper, not the run() path — runtime fix matches MainActivity.kt:527 pattern, regression surface untested. Filed as test-tightening followup if desired.

followup-authstore-mainthread-io.title: AuthStore.set main-thread I/O regression
followup-authstore-mainthread-io.description: MainActivityIntentApplier.kt:16 documents that AuthStore.set does encrypted-prefs init + disk I/O and must NOT run on main thread. Three call sites still violate this: LlmAuthSettingsPage.kt:215 (per-keystroke API-key persistence), OnboardingViewModel.kt:104+219 (onboarding writes), MainActivity.kt:751 (settings OAuth writes). UI-jank risk.
acceptCriteria: All AuthStore.set calls offloaded via Dispatchers.IO or equivalent
followup-authstore-mainthread-io.note: Surfaced by holistic codex review. Likely predates harness-simplify milestone but worth tracking.
